notes: Geography -> weather-observation-region mapping for Weather / Climate Context V1 (2026-08-21). Each entry is a named, publicly-documented berry production region, not an invented farm coordinate -- the centroid is a single representative point within that real region, chosen for NASA POWER point-query purposes. NASA POWER's own native grid resolution is ~0.5 degrees (~50km); a single point is a coarse proxy for the named region, not a field-level reading. Country-level Geography entities (data/entities/geographies/) remain the canonical entity; this file adds a subnational production-region layer underneath them without creating new Geography entities or modifying Variety/Landscape UI. 'piloted: true' entries were queried live this mission (see docs/v2/WEATHER-CLIMATE-CONTEXT-V1.md Part 5); 'piloted: false' entries are documented for completeness (the mission's own priority-geography list) but were not queried, per the mission's own bounded-pilot instruction.

regions.source: Chile's principal blueberry-growing region (Maule/Nuble/Biobio belt), per Hortifrut's and the Chilean Blueberry Committee/ASOEX's own public production-geography descriptions -- consistent with geography-chile.json's existing Hortifrut evidence.
regions.coverage_caveat: One point near Talca; real Chilean blueberry production spans multiple regions (Maule south through Nuble/Biobio and north into O'Higgins) at a range of latitudes with different local conditions.

regions.source: Peru's largest blueberry-production region per USDA FAS GAIN reporting and industry coverage (Viru/Chao coastal desert valleys, home to Camposol/Hortifrut-scale operations) -- a coastal desert, irrigation-dependent production zone distinct from Peru's highland agriculture.
regions.coverage_caveat: One point in the Viru/Chao valley; Peru's blueberry belt also extends into Ica and Lambayeque, not separately queried this pilot.

regions.region_name: Western Cape (Ceres/Tulbagh/Paarl berry belt), South Africa
regions.source: South Africa's principal berry-growing area per industry/export-body (Hortgro/SABGA-adjacent) descriptions -- the Ceres/Tulbagh/Paarl corridor of the Western Cape.
regions.coverage_caveat: One point in the Ceres/Tulbagh area; South African blueberry production also occurs in Limpopo/Mpumalanga under different climate conditions, not queried this pilot.

regions.source: Morocco's principal red-fruit/berry export region per industry coverage (Kenitra/Larache, the Gharb-Loukkos coastal plain) -- the same region referenced generically in Moroccan berry trade-press coverage already in this dataset.
regions.coverage_caveat: One point near Kenitra; Morocco's berry belt extends along the Atlantic coastal plain, not uniformly sampled by a single point.

regions.source: Mexico's classic winter/spring fresh-strawberry export region (Zamora, Michoacan, and the neighboring Irapuato, Guanajuato district) -- the real production geography underlying the US antidumping proceeding's subject merchandise (fresh strawberries from Mexico).
regions.coverage_caveat: One point near Zamora; Mexico's strawberry production is split across Michoacan (winter/spring) and Baja California (summer), and this pilot queries only the Michoacan point, matching the antidumping case's real winter/spring harvest timing.

regions.region_name: California Central Coast (Salinas/Watsonville/Santa Maria), United States
regions.source: The dominant US fresh-strawberry and caneberry production region per California Strawberry Commission / USDA NASS regional reporting (Salinas-Watsonville-Santa Maria corridor).
regions.coverage_caveat: Not queried this pilot -- no real trade anomaly case from Trade Intelligence V1 required US-as-exporter weather context. Included for completeness against the mission's own named priority-geography list.

regions.region_name: Pacific Northwest (Willamette Valley OR / Whatcom County WA), United States
regions.source: The dominant US Pacific Northwest berry region (Willamette Valley, Oregon, and Whatcom County, Washington) per Oregon/Washington state agriculture department and industry-association reporting.
regions.coverage_caveat: Not queried this pilot -- no real trade anomaly case required it. Included for completeness.

regions.source: The UK's traditional soft-fruit growing county (Kent), consistent with this dataset's own existing UK retail/variety evidence (e.g. Berry Gardens/Driscoll's Victoria blackberry, grown in Kent).
regions.coverage_caveat: Not queried this pilot -- the UK appears in this mission's trade cases only as an importer (Morocco/South Africa mirror lanes), not as a production geography under weather stress. Included for completeness.

regions.source: Spain's dominant berry-export region (Huelva), consistent with this dataset's own existing Freshuelva evidence.
regions.coverage_caveat: Not queried this pilot -- no real trade anomaly case from Trade Intelligence V1 covered Spain. Included for completeness.
